audit.why: Renata's long-range Loyalty Program (E) root and Bailout (W) let her dictate the opening safely through level 3, while Taric's double-cast Q/Bastion/Dazzle chain only comes fully online from level 5-6 onward. Content layer already reflects this.
audit.corrected: phases[0-2].side -> Renata; phases[4-6].side -> Taric; ratings and whys rewritten to match. phases[3] left alone.

audit.why: Level 6 (Cosmic Radiance controls the ADC through Hostile Takeover berserk), first item (double-cast Q/Bastion out-sustains her utility poke), and late (peel neutralizes root-and-flip engage) are already correctly stated in spikes[].

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Bank R for the Hostile Takeover flip — Cosmic Radiance controls your ADC through the berserk, so hold it.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Linking the wrong ally when she Bailouts her own carry wastes your Bastion shield entirely.

edits.before: - Renata Glasc Hostile Takeover: matchup-defining — The berserk wave turns your team on itself — never group in a line against it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Renata Glasc Hostile Takeover (150/130/110s by rank) turns your team berserk on itself — never group in a line against it, since the duo's whole tempo bends around it. - Keep your R Cosmic Radiance (180/150/120s) banked for it, not a habit.

edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: Bailout and E-root threat let her dictate the opening safely — Bravado-weave what trades you take, but don't force it.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: Loyalty Program root sets up kills faster than your single-point heal can answer — the gemstone economy isn't open yet.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: Her utility poke stays ahead of your sustain at 3 — W-link the carry and hold E for her committed root.

edits.before: Cosmic Radiance online — dives on your duo meet a scheduled invulnerability.
edits.after: Double-cast heal, shield and stun come online and out-sustain her poke — dives on your duo meet a scheduled invulnerability.

edits.before: First item: the stuns chain and the heals compound.
edits.after: First item: heal-shield-stun chain outvalues her utility attrition, keeping the edge yours.

edits.before: Late Taric un-kills teamfights: R the dive, link the carry, and stun the formation twice per rotation.
edits.after: Late, R immunity and peel neutralize her root-and-flip engage entirely — her pick has nowhere to land.
